newsitem.title: USA: USG gypsum sales, earnings up in Q2.
newsitem.headline: USG gypsum sales, earnings up in Q2.

text.p: USG Corp, which makes gypsum wallboard, joint compound and other products, said Monday its North American gypsum business had net sales of $589 million in the second quarter, up 15 percent from a year ago.
Earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortization (EBITDA) rose 34 percent to $137 million in the second quarter.

U.S. Gypsum's wallboard plants ran at 98 percent of capacity in the second quarter. Its average selling price of $123.42 per thousand square feet was up about three percent from the first quarter and 16 percent higher than a year ago.
Second-quarter shipments of gypsum wallboard totaled 2.06 billion square feet, a record for any second quarter and five percent above the year-ago period.
The gypsum division of Canada-based CGC Inc had second-quarter net sales of $30 million, up seven percent from a year ago. EBITDA was $4 million, flat with a year ago.

USG said its worldwide ceilings business had net sales of $159 million, up three percent from a year ago. Excluding the insulation manufacturing business sold in April 1996, sales rose five percent. EBITDA was $22 million, up 29 percent from a year ago.
Earlier, USG reported second-quarter earnings of $0.55 a share, up from $0.09. EBITDA for the company was $147 million, a record since its 1993 restructuring, up from $110 million a year ago.
